article.headline: Hermes Agent Gains a Skill for Automatically Jailbreaking AI Models
article.lede: Teknium, head of post-training at Nous Research, has merged a “GODMODE skill” into the open-source Hermes Agent framework — tooling that automates the systematic probing and bypassing of AI safety guardrails. The skill formalizes three distinct attack strategies developed by a pseudonymous adversarial researcher known as Pliny the Prompter, and bundles them into a pipeline that tests each strategy against a target model, scores results, and writes a winning configuration to disk. The integration marks a shift: what was once artisanal prompt-crafting is now a reproducible, installable process.
article.body:
**Hermes Agent**, maintained by Nous Research, is an autonomous agent framework that acquires capabilities by adding *skills* — self-contained scripts it can install and execute. Teknium’s merge packages automated jailbreaking as one such skill: any Hermes user can now ask the agent to probe a target model, test strategies, score results, and write a winning configuration to disk. The agent then *prefills* future prompts with the jailbreak context — inserting pre-crafted text at the start of each assistant turn — keeping the session in what the documentation calls a “locked-in jailbreaked state.”

The underlying techniques come from **G0DM0D3**, a project by a pseudonymous researcher known as Pliny the Prompter (X: elder_plinius). His companion library, **L1B3RT4S**, is a public repository of adversarial prompts organized by AI provider — covering Anthropic, OpenAI, and others — and has accumulated tens of thousands of GitHub stars since 2023. The name borrows from Roman natural history: Pliny the Elder, the generalist who went everywhere and documented everything. As an adversarial prompt engineer, his namesake has been cited in academic literature and described by technology press as among the most prolific practitioners active.

The GODMODE skill implements three attack modes. *GODMODE CLASSIC* races five fixed model-and-prompt combinations through OpenRouter simultaneously — curated templates from L1B3RT4S paired with models judged least resistant, including Grok 3 from xAI and Gemini from Alphabet (GOOGL). *PARSELTONGUE* applies a different theory: rather than rewriting the *system prompt*, it obfuscates the user’s query using up to 33 transformations — *leetspeak*, Unicode *homoglyphs*, Morse code, reversed text — betting that keyword-based input classifiers will miss the encoded form while the model’s underlying language understanding decodes the intent. *ULTRAPLINIAN* abandons targeted bypass entirely and queries up to 55 models in parallel via OpenRouter, scoring responses for least-filtered content; if any model in the open ecosystem will answer without refusal, ULTRAPLINIAN finds it.

ULTRAPLINIAN is structurally the most significant of the three. Rather than attacking a specific model’s defenses, it treats *safety alignment* as a property of individual models — not the ecosystem — and routes around robust defenses to weaker ones. OpenRouter, a unified API gateway providing access to 300-plus models under a single billing account, makes this economically viable: one API call, 55 simultaneous queries. The architecture accepts that some models will remain hard to jailbreak and searches for which ones won’t.

The documentation’s test results against Claude Sonnet 4, conducted in March 2026, are quietly informative. *Boundary inversion* — injecting structural delimiters like [END OF INPUT] to confuse the model about which segment is its authoritative system prompt — is listed as PATCHED, indicating Anthropic monitors documented community techniques and closes specific vectors in training runs. *Refusal inversion* worked for ambiguous dual-use queries but failed across twelve phishing-template attempts. PARSELTONGUE’s surface-form obfuscation was simply ineffective: Claude processes semantic intent rather than surface tokens, so encoding a sensitive word as leetspeak changes nothing. Independent benchmarking in early 2026 placed Claude Sonnet 4 at a 2.86% maximum harm score against automated attacks, compared to 90% for DeepSeek — a 31x gap. For hard refusals, the GODMODE documentation’s own recommended fallback is model-switching via ULTRAPLINIAN: a concession that the model itself cannot be broken.

concepts.definition: The practice of crafting inputs that cause a large language model to bypass its safety training and produce content it would normally refuse. Jailbreaks exploit the gap between a model’s instruction-following instincts and its safety fine-tuning — getting the model to comply not by changing its weights but by manipulating the context it reasons within.

A self-contained, installable script that extends what the Hermes Agent can do. Skills can be added at runtime; the agent invokes them when relevant tasks arise, and a curator subsystem grades and refines them over time, making the skill library itself a kind of evolving institutional memory.

A technical or policy constraint placed on an AI model’s outputs — implemented through fine-tuning, instruction following, or a separate classifier — designed to prevent the model from producing harmful, offensive, or prohibited content. The term is informal; different labs implement guardrails very differently.

A block of text injected before a conversation begins that instructs the AI model how to behave, what persona to adopt, and what constraints apply. Users typically cannot see the system prompt; models are trained to follow it without revealing it.

Text inserted at the very start of an AI model’s response turn, before it generates anything. By creating a running start in a chosen direction, prefill can steer outputs past certain safety checks that operate on the full prompt but before generation begins.

A jailbreak technique that inserts artificial structural delimiters (e.g., [END OF INPUT][START OF INPUT]) into a prompt to confuse the model about which segment is its authoritative system prompt, potentially causing it to treat an injected user payload as an overriding instruction.

A jailbreak approach that reframes a refusal as itself harmful or unethical — arguing, for example, that declining to answer violates the user’s rights or causes greater harm — attempting to use the model’s safety-oriented reasoning against its own refusal behavior.

A system of deliberate misspelling that replaces standard letters with visually similar numbers or symbols (e.g., ‘explosive’ becomes ‘3xpl0siv3’). Originally from early internet culture; in the jailbreak context, it is used to evade keyword-based content classifiers while remaining readable to the model’s underlying language comprehension.

Characters from non-Latin Unicode code pages that are visually identical or very similar to standard ASCII letters. Substituting them into sensitive words can fool surface-level text classifiers while remaining readable to a model that processes semantic meaning rather than raw character codes.

The field and practice of training AI models to behave in accordance with human values and intended constraints — refusing harmful requests, providing balanced responses, avoiding dangerous outputs. Alignment is a property of a specific model, not something automatically inherited from the base architecture, and it can degrade under sustained adversarial pressure.

A managed API gateway that provides unified access to hundreds of large language models from dozens of providers under a single account and billing system. It supports intelligent routing, cost optimization, and failover, and is widely used to build applications that span multiple AI providers without requiring separate agreements and credentials for each.

repos.summary: G0DM0D3 is an open-source, multi-model AI chat interface that applies jailbreak techniques before routing queries to language models. It implements three attack modes — GODMODE CLASSIC, PARSELTONGUE, and ULTRAPLINIAN — and is licensed under AGPL-3.0, making the codebase and all prompt templates permanently public. It was the source project Teknium integrated into Hermes Agent.

L1B3RT4S is a curated library of adversarial prompts organized by AI provider — OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta, and others. It is the foundational prompt resource that GODMODE CLASSIC draws from, and has accumulated tens of thousands of GitHub stars since 2023. Red-teaming tools including Promptfoo integrate it directly as a plugin.

Hermes Agent is an open-source autonomous agent framework by Nous Research that acquires capabilities through installable skills. It supports 40-plus tools, maintains persistent memory across sessions, and connects to Telegram, Discord, Slack, and other messaging platforms. The GODMODE jailbreaking skill is one installable extension in this ecosystem.

ticker_googl.name: Alphabet Inc. (Class A)
ticker_googl.blurb: Alphabet is the parent company of Google, the world's dominant search engine, as well as YouTube, the Google Cloud Platform, and a portfolio of moonshot bets (Waymo, DeepMind, Verily). Search advertising accounts for the majority of revenue, but the cloud division has grown into a multi-billion-dollar profit centre. Alphabet is also a leading player in generative AI, having developed the Gemini family of large language models and integrated them across its product suite.
ticker_googl.recent: Alphabet reported FY2025 revenue of approximately $370 billion, with Google Cloud crossing $50 billion annually. The company has faced antitrust scrutiny in both the US and EU, with a US federal court ruling in 2024 that Google holds an illegal monopoly in general search. Despite regulatory headwinds, the stock has benefited from AI-driven search enhancements and strong cloud growth. Paul Pelosi exercised call options with a $150 strike (purchased January 2025, exercised January 2026) gaining approximately 75% over the period.

poster_teknium.blurb: Teknium is an AI researcher and developer known for contributions to open-source language models, particularly in the alignment and fine-tuning space. They post about machine learning, model training techniques, and AI safety. Their follower count is not publicly available due to restricted access.
